supporting_observations.claim: The repeated outbound connections in the alert window are to update.gradebookpro.com and are associated with C:\Program Files\GradeBookPro\gradebookproupd.exe. For example, the proxy records show connections at 13:37:44, 13:42:39, 13:51:57, 13:56:59, 14:02:21, and 14:07:25; endpoint network events identify the updater process for those connections.

The observed intervals are roughly five minutes, and the inventory identifies gradebookproupd.exe checking update.gradebookpro.com about every five minutes as approved behavior. The alerted periodicity and destination therefore match the documented updater pattern.

Some updater attempts did not succeed: the proxy denied a connection at 13:47:35 and returned a gateway error at 14:07:25. The matching endpoint events still attribute those attempts to gradebookproupd.exe; the outcomes do not indicate a different destination or process.

known_telemetry_limitations: The stated winsec and Sysmon collection outage affects WS-THART-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, not the alerted host WS-RDIAZ-01. The supplied coverage status reports those sensors as OK on other hosts.
The supplied updater connection records show proxy CONNECT metadata and endpoint network attribution, but do not establish the contents of the HTTPS exchanges or the integrity of any update payload.
claims_not_established: The records do not establish what data, if any, was exchanged inside the updater's HTTPS sessions.
The records do not independently verify the updater executable's signature, hash, or the integrity of any downloaded update.
unrelated_findings: Separate review recommended: FILE-ORC-01 initiated an RDP connection to WS-RDIAZ-01 at 13:51:27, although the supplied environment context says remote administration is only performed from WS-SBYRNE-01. Related FILE-ORC-01-to-workstation connection attempts also appear in the same period. These are not the alerted outbound GradeBook Pro activity. (T286-00388, T286-00386, T286-00393)

Separate review recommended: taskhostw.exe on WS-RDIAZ-01 used explicit credentials for svc-safe at 14:02:19. The inventory describes svc-safe as a backup-agent account on FILE-ORC-01; these records do not establish why it was used on this workstation or connect it to the alerted updater connections. (T286-00444)
